test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 7 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Man of letters
solution:
The correct answer is '**Scholar**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **most appropriate** meaning of the given idiom '**Men of letters**' is '**Scholar**'.
 
• **Men of letters**- *someone who is an expert in the arts and literature, and often a writer too*
 
 
• **Example:** *He is a man of great experience, a man of letters and of law.*
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's understand the other options.
 
 
• **Dancer**- *a person who dances, often as a job.*
 
• **Singer**- *a person who sings.*
 
• **Actor**- *a person who acts; whether in a movie or theatre.*
